text:
After a spirited stretch, we are glad to have your comments, and we are sorry that your journey was disrupted and that your companion animal was placed in an unacceptable position of stress and uncertainty. You reported that your booking was mishandled after a missed connection, that your animal care arrangements were not carried through as promised, and that the response you received from our team did not show the urgency and respect that Aurelia Skyways requires.

We have reviewed the matter with the Companion Animal Travel Desk and the operations staff involved. <<FACT F110>> We recognize that this outcome did not reflect the care standards we must uphold for every traveler and every animal in our custody. A welfare coordinator has already been instructed to revisit the handling notes for your case, and the crew guidance process is being reinforced so that comfort measures, feeding arrangements, loading sequences, and recovery checks are followed without delay. Our team is also reviewing the communication path used during the disruption so that travelers receive clear updates before concern escalates.

Please accept our sincere apology for the distress caused. We understand that companion animals depend on calm treatment, familiar handling, and careful attention to their condition, and we regret that this was not delivered as it should have been. The department has reminded all staff that special care plans must be matched to the animal's temperament and physical needs, and that any lapse in transfer or custody handling must be escalated at once. This review is active now, and it is being treated as urgent.

We value your report because it helps us correct failures that should not recur. If you choose to travel again with Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk will ensure that your concerns are flagged in advance so that the next handling team is prepared with clearer instructions and stronger oversight. We remain committed to restoring trust through direct action, not wording alone.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
